ketch for macOS

Design system · Liquid Glass

Catch releases.
Keep them in glass.

Glossy Liquid Glass controls float over frosted content and a soft mesh. One accent, Tide, marks what you can act on; four status colours say what state a package is in. Everything on this page is drawn from tokens.json, the same file that generates the app's Tokens.swift.

Main window

Liquid Glass is the control layer: sidebar, toolbar controls, the floating activity bar. Content stays below it: the list sits on the canvas and the detail is a frosted card. Glass never stacks on glass.

Foundations

Every value below is read from the generated token index; the swatches are live, so they follow the switches above.

Colour

Light and dark values under each swatch; high-contrast values show when Increase contrast is on.

Typography

SF Pro, with optical sizes chosen by the system; SF Mono for versions, paths and log lines.

Spacing

A 4-point scale.

Radii

Concentric: a child's radius is its parent's minus the padding between them.

Elevation

Key and ambient shadows plus an inset rim light on top and shade below: the 3D edge.

Motion

Click to play. Under Reduce motion every curve collapses to a short fade.
